input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: The only indemnity in the Agreement (Article XII, p0128-p0129) runs one way against us: Licensee indemnifies Licensor broadly for its exercise of the licence, the conduct of its business and any breach. There is no Licensor indemnity anywhere, and Article XIII (p0130) compounds this by expressly disclaiming any Licensor liability for claims that use of the Licensed Technology infringes third-party intellectual property, on top of the non-infringement warranty disclaimer. That is walk-away territory under the rule (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity) and fails the fallback, which at minimum requires a Vendor IP indemnity. The redline adds a Licensor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics carved out of Article XIII, and narrows our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our breach.

proposal.summary: Add a Licensor indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity in Article XII.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs only against us, and Article XIII expressly excludes Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we have no protection if the Licensed Technology infringes a third party's rights. We have added a reciprocal Licensor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and wilful misconduct, and narrowed our own indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our breach; if preferred, we can accept the usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications) and remedies plus a 3x annual fees super-cap.

ops.text: ARTICLE XII-A LICENSOR INDEMNITY Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the API's, the Documentation or any deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (d) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Licensee shall give Licensor prompt written notice of the claim, Licensor shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on Licensee shall be made without Licensee's prior written consent), and Licensee shall provide reasonable cooperation at Licensor's expense. Licensor's obligations under this Article are not subject to the exclusions or limitations of liability set forth in Article XIII.
